$comment: Hard gzip budgets are KiB limits for bundled+minified ESM with optional peers externalized. The exact reviewed byte map was measured on the final integrated source set with Node 22.23.2, esbuild's production minifier, and gzip level 9. Whole-byte ceilings are expressed in KiB; validation rejects a missing/stale measurement, a ceiling below its measurement, or headroom above 4%. Refreshed general ceilings use 3.5% portability headroom beneath that hard maximum. Rebaseline by running check-bundle-size.mjs --print-budget-review after the source and dist set is final, then review and copy the exact measurements without exceeding the printed maxima. Existing tighter canaries stay tighter: button is capped at 31 KiB -- it sat at 30 KiB after its direct form helpers, external-label bridge, and ARIA reflection path were separated from the general form mixin, composed-focus collector, and multi-owner description runtime, and the whole-KiB step above absorbs the base class's cross-document render-root fallback, which every bundle shares; localization, combobox, and popover also retain their tighter whole-KiB ceilings. Metafile inspection and peer-inclusive exclusion checks remain independently blocking. Popover and combobox carry no-splitting total-cost ceilings here; separately reviewed initial marginal ceilings live in bundle-initial-budgets.json so deferral cannot disguise total growth.
